title: tttrlib photon-simulation config
description: Configuration accepted by tttrlib.SimEngine.from_json(...) — the single entry point for the photon simulator. Diffusion, rate, and brightness quantities share ONE abstract macro-time unit (the ms convention is common); the micro-time / TAC axis is a separate axis in nanoseconds. See the simulator manual for the full physics and the routing-channel configuration model (FRET, PIE, MFD, anisotropy).

_comment.description: Free-text description of the configuration (ignored by the engine).

settings.description: Time base, RNG, micro-time axis, stop conditions, and opt-in throughput knobs (SimIntegrator).

dt.description: Diffusion/integration time-window in the macro-time unit (ms convention: 0.001 = 1 µs). Sets diffusion resolution; do not enlarge for speed (sub-stepped internally).

n_ph_max.description: Stop after this many photons (fixed-count mode). Use max_windows for a fixed duration.

max_windows.description: Fixed-DURATION stop: duration = max_windows × dt (0 = unlimited). Required by independent_molecules; then n_ph_max is ignored.

n_channels.description: Number of detection (routing) channels = product of the physical routings (spectral × polarization × PIE window).

seed_diffusion.description: RNG seed for diffusion, geometry and state transitions.

seed_emission.description: RNG seed for emission, channel choice and background.

n_microtime_channels.description: Number of micro-time (TCSPC/TAC) channels on the fluorescence-decay axis.

microtime_resolution.description: Micro-time channel width in NANOSECONDS (TAC resolution).

laser_period.description: Pulsed-excitation period in NANOSECONDS; micro-times wrap modulo this. Its sub-windows carry PIE prompt/delay.

alex_period.description: ALEX (alternating laser excitation) period in MACRO-time units (same as dt). With >= 2 excitation grids each macro-window is assigned to laser floor(fmod(T0*dt, alex_period)/(alex_period/n_lasers)) — a macro-time laser alternation (unlike laser_period, the ns TCSPC pulse). 0 = off (single laser).

alex_markers.description: Emit a marker event (event_type = alex_marker_event_type, routing channel = laser index) at each ALEX laser switch, as explicit ground truth. Preserved by lossless containers; dropped by SM.

alex_marker_event_type.description: event_type written for ALEX laser-switch markers (scan markers use 1).

rng_kind.description: RNG backend. All are thread-count-independent; xoshiro is the fast default.

rng_scope.description: RNG stream granularity. per_molecule is reproducible regardless of thread count.

per_molecule_skip.description: Coasting: skip per-window work for molecules far from the focus; exact catch-up on wake. Big speedup for dilute samples.

coast_safety.description: Coast bound: step std ≤ distance-to-boundary / coast_safety. Only used with coasting.

min_coast_windows.description: Minimum sleep length in windows. Only used with coasting.

focus_threshold.description: Fraction of peak excitation defining the effective-focus box used by coasting, the two-step lookup and active_margin.

fast_grid_bbox.description: Two-step field lookup: reject far-from-focus queries with a bounding box before the trilinear interpolation.

independent_molecules.description: Simulate each molecule's whole timeline independently and merge — parallel across molecules. Requires max_windows > 0; ignores n_ph_max.

active_margin.description: Open-volume: shrink the box to focus+margin (µm), holding concentration, so far molecules are skipped. Exact for diffusion; for kinetics use margin ≳ √(2·D/k). 0 = off.

box.description: Ellipsoidal open-volume box (µm). With population, sets the concentration = M / box volume.

species.description: Photophysical / conformational states. Model each emitting state (donor-excited, acceptor-via-FRET, dark, directly-excited-acceptor for PIE, …) as a species; FRET E, PIE window and per-channel lifetime are encoded via q + decay, not new physics.

D.description: Translational diffusion coefficient, µm² per macro-time unit (ms ⇒ µm²/ms). 0 = immobile.

q.description: Peak brightness per channel (photons per macro-time unit at the focus centre). The channel split encodes FRET color routing / anisotropy; q_green ∝ (1−E), q_red ∝ E.

q_alex.description: ALEX per-laser brightness rows q_alex[laser][channel] (one row per excitation grid). Empty ⇒ q broadcast to all lasers. A doubly-labelled FRET species uses [[(1-E)b, E·b], [0, b_A]] so it emits DD+DA under the green laser and AA under the red laser.

r0.description: Fundamental anisotropy. >0 enables photoselection + depolarization (needs a decay).

D_rot.description: Rotational diffusion coefficient, rad²/ns; depolarizes over the lifetime (Perrin).

v_scale.description: Coupling of this species to the global flow field. 0 = not advected (e.g. surface-bound).

k_rad.description: N×N row-major (i→j) transition rates SCALED by local excitation intensity (photo-induced / FRET-type), per macro-time unit. Length N_species².

k_nrad.description: N×N row-major (i→j) SPONTANEOUS transition rates (blinking, conformational exchange), per macro-time unit. Length N_species².

background.description: Uncorrelated background rate per channel (photons per macro-time unit).

background_decay.description: Optional micro-time pattern for background photons (scatter/IRF or flat); broadcast to all channels.

population.description: Open-volume expected molecule count per species in the box (index = species).

flow.description: Uniform velocity field, Poiseuille flow, rigid rotation, or a field from three component arrays. A divergence-free field must be used for a stationary, homogeneous correlation analysis (see the simulator guide).

type.description: Flow-field type. uniform: constant vx,vy,vz (analytic, no lattice). poiseuille: Hagen-Poiseuille pipe flow along axis. rotation: rigid-body rotation about axis. components: arbitrary field from three same-shaped voxel arrays.

axis.description: Flow axis: 0=x, 1=y, 2=z. For poiseuille the axis of the pipe; for rotation the axis of rotation.

extent_xy.description: Grid half-extent XY (µm) for poiseuille/rotation lattice.

extent_z.description: Grid half-extent Z (µm) for poiseuille/rotation lattice.

nx.description: Grid X dimension for components type.

ny.description: Grid Y dimension for components type.

nz.description: Grid Z dimension for components type.

dx.description: X voxel spacing (µm) for components type.

dy.description: Y voxel spacing (µm) for components type.

dz.description: Z voxel spacing (µm) for components type.

x0.description: Physical X origin of the components lattice.

y0.description: Physical Y origin of the components lattice.

z0.description: Physical Z origin of the components lattice.

occlusion.description: Occlusion mask: a scalar field in [0,1] where 0 = free, 1 = impermeable. Molecules propose a step and accept it with probability 1 − occ(destination). A slab thinner than 4·sqrt(2·D·dt) may be tunnelled. Partial occlusion (0 < occ < 1) combined with flow is outside the validated regime.

data.description: Occlusion values in [0,1], row-major with x fastest. Size must be nx*ny*nz.

emitters.description: Explicit discrete fluorophores (e.g. immobile emitters for CLSM). Alternative to open-volume population.

excitation.description: Excitation intensity field. A single field object = one laser (current behavior); an array of field objects = one per ALEX laser (with settings.alex_period > 0).

detection.description: Detection-efficiency field per channel (size == n_channels). Empty = uniform efficiency 1. Lateral x0/y0 offsets between channels give ISM.

field.description: Excitation/detection field. Either an analytic/parametric focus or a numeric/measured PSF filling a voxel grid.

extent_xy.description: Grid half-extent XY (µm); size to the focus, not the box, for cheap construction.

rz.description: radial only: PSF on the (r,z) half-plane, row-major [iz*nr+ir].

nr.description: radial only: number of r samples.

nz.description: radial only: number of z samples (z-centred).

decay.description: Micro-time (FLIM/lifetime) pattern for a species or the background. Either a raw 'pattern' array or a multi-exponential built from 'lifetimes' (+ 'amplitudes', optional 'irf'). 't0' shifts the pattern within the laser period — used to place PIE prompt vs delayed emission.

t0.description: Micro-time of bin 0 (ns); offset within the laser period for PIE.

pattern.description: Arbitrary (unnormalised) decay density over micro-time bins.

lifetimes.description: Fluorescence lifetimes (ns) for a multi-exponential decay.

n_bins.description: Number of bins for the multi-exponential build.

irf.description: Optional IRF pattern to convolve with the multi-exponential decay.
